propositions: Plan-review attestations must sign deterministic pins for all direct children and prerequisites, binding their current narrow material fingerprints at review time
When enforcement is enabled, material drift in a pinned related ticket invalidates the downstream attestation; propagation is natural rather than eager
Execution-phase reviews apply a fixed 0.80 priority floor in Pass-3 blocking-threshold resolution for already-started work, while planning-phase reviews remain unchanged

The close gate requires a current certified plan review only when both require_plan_review_for_close and enforce_plan_material_pins are enabled; code freshness alone never invalidates the close-profile review

Every readable prerequisite receives exactly one three-disposition coverage record; complete prerequisite coverage is required for certification, so any indeterminate record yields an unsigned INDETERMINATE review

Pre-sign collection aborts after any concurrent relationship or fingerprint change, and signing occurs under a single atomic transaction capturing subject material, phase, and pinned fingerprints with ticket-store HEAD verification
